enforcement_authorities: 人工知能戦略本部 (AI Strategy Headquarters)
内閣府科学技術・イノベーション推進事務局
implementation_notes: This document establishes the AI Strategy Expert Panel (人工知能戦略専門調査会) under Cabinet Order No. 281 of Reiwa 7 (2025), pursuant to the Act on Promotion of Research, Development and Utilization of AI-Related Technologies (Act No. 53 of Reiwa 7). The panel is tasked with investigating guidelines (Article 13), research and surveys (Article 16), and basic plans (Article 18). Members are appointed by the Prime Minister from persons with expertise in AI. The panel may invite external experts and establish working groups.
